title: Single-device platform credential, no attestation
description: Platform authenticator, BE=0 BS=0, non-discoverable. Classic device-bound single-device credential without attestation.

title: Backup-eligible but not currently backed up
description: BE=1 BS=0: multi-device credential, not currently backed up. Synced-capable passkey that has not yet been backed up.

title: Backup-eligible and currently backed up (synced)
description: BE=1 BS=1: multi-device credential currently backed up. Typical synced passkey.

title: Invalid combination BE=0 BS=1
description: BE=0 BS=1 is not allowed per WebAuthn L3 Table BE/BS combinations. Tests that BS=1 requires BE=1.

title: Device-bound passkey (discoverable, single-device) with attestation
description: Discoverable + single-device: FIDO still calls this a passkey (device-bound passkey). Has packed self-attestation.

title: Synced passkey with packed attestation
description: BE=1 BS=1 discoverable with attestation. Attestation informs RP policy but is not proof the credential is hardware-bound.

title: Roaming authenticator, backup-eligible not backed up
description: Roaming authenticator that is still BE=1 BS=0. Demonstrates roaming != automatically non-synced / BE=0.

title: Platform authenticator, single-device, discoverable (device-bound passkey)
description: Platform authenticator does not automatically mean synced. This is a platform device-bound passkey.

title: Single-device, no attestation — lack of attestation does not prove synced
description: Roaming single-device without attestation. Missing attestation by itself does not prove the credential is synced.

title: Synced credential, discoverable, no attestation, BS=1
description: Synced multi-device backed-up credential without attestation. Shows synced state comes from BE/BS, not attestation.
